verdict.rationale: Otter documents automations such as auto-joining meetings, syncing action items to CRMs and task tools, and webhooks, so a buyer could fairly ask about versioning them. Nothing in the pack shows version history, review, or rollback for those automations. The account-level audit trails and activity logs are an adjacent compliance feature, not automation versioning or rollback, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
